title: quercus petraea subsp. polycarpa
intro: Quercus petraea subsp. polycarpa, commonly known as the sessile oak, is a subspecies of deciduous tree native to Europe and Western Asia. The health benefits of Quercus petraea subsp. polycarpa include its potential to lower cholesterol levels, reduce inflammation, and protect against oxidative stress due to its high content of antioxidants. The therapeutic actions of this plant are believed to be due to its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which may aid in treating various health conditions such as cardiovascular diseases and certain types of cancer. The bioactive constituents of Quercus petraea subsp. polycarpa include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and tannins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
